The Redhawks, led by second-year head coach [[Rick Ray (basketball)|Rick Ray]], played their home games at the [[Show Me Center]] in [[Cape Girardeau, Missouri]] as members of the West Division of the [[Ohio Valley Conference]]. They finished the season 15–18, 9–7 in OVC play to finish in second place in the West Division. They defeated [[2016–17 Tennessee State Tigers basketball team|Tennessee State]] in the first round of the [[2017 Ohio Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|OVC tournament]] to advance to the quarterfinals where they lost to [[2016–17 Jacksonville State Gamecocks men's basketball team|Jacksonville State]]. ==Previous season== The [[2015–16 Southeast Missouri State Redhawks men's basketball team|Redhawks]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 5–24, 2–14 in OVC play to finish in last place in the West Division. As a result, they failed to qualify for the [[2016 Ohio Valley Conference men's basketball tournament|OVC tournament]]. == Preseaon == In a vote of Ohio Valley Conference head men’s basketball coaches and sports information directors, Southeast Missouri State was picked to finish last in the West Division of the OVC.{{Cite
